An '''attack''' on the [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] took place in the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
During [[Operation Skyhook]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] made a surprise attack on the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] near [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]], site of an important [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'' just ended its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] jump next to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''Defiance''.

==The battle==
The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''Immortal'' entered the system and deployed its [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]]. [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron's]] [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|A-wings]] managed to destroy many Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and allowed the ''Defiance'' to escape in hyperspace.
